desc: 香芋紫渐变与奶油质感串联的八镜身体清洁转化套图
name: 香草奶油调温和沐浴露款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用干净的翻盖瓶正身拿走首图流量
一秒传达甜点感香氛主张，用香调道具承接首图情绪
用俯视微距质地与三段空白香调框解释气味结构
以冲洗中的身体泡沫给买家自我代入，并用空白主张位承接信任点
用侧影倾倒的连贯凝胶线证明奶油凝胶质地而非稀薄液体
以高角度使用步骤降低用法疑虑，编号位保持空白可替换
把单品扩成可搭配的 trio 组合，用引线空白框做无字样说明
以整列香型与底部空白信任位收口，去掉任何徽章与星级

style.backgroundSystem: alternating fields: seamless packshot white #FFFFFF, cream info surface #F4EEE4, and a smooth lavender gradient scene field from #C3B2E6 to #A99AD6
style.iconSystem: thin-line bubble-and-sparkle icons in one accent color #E13C86, no filled or 3D icons, no seal artwork
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light, large front-left softbox key with a white fill card, soft contact shadows, single controlled gloss highlight on wet or gelled surfaces, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium body-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, soft cream #F4EEE4, diffuse lavender scene field #B7A6DE and one magenta accent #E13C86; neutral-cool studio lighting with a large front-left softbox key, a white fill card and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif layout type with all wording kept as empty placeholder frames; consistent thin-line bubble icon style in a single accent color; backgrounds alternate between clean white, cream and lavender fields; stable upright product scale and centring across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no source brand marks.
noDrift: no serif or script display lettering
style.presentationRules: upright bottle with a consistent slight 3/4 or straight-on scale across the set, label plane always facing the camera, props and hands never covering the product silhouette
style.surfaceSystem: glossy reflective shelf ledge for display shots, matte cream stone slab for texture and macro shots
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif layout type only; every wording slot stays an empty placeholder frame in this template
